title: fix(providers): report input/output tokens for interrupted pydantic-ai runs

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+**Interrupted agent runs**: partial results from the pydantic-ai provider now
+report `input_tokens` and `output_tokens` instead of `None`.

@@ -453,8 +453,8 @@ def _usage_from_result(result: AgentRunResult[Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | N
     usage = result.usage
     return {
         "requests": getattr(usage, "requests", None),
-        "request_tokens": getattr(usage, "request_tokens", None),
-        "response_tokens": getattr(usage, "response_tokens", None),
+        "input_tokens": getattr(usage, "input_tokens", None),
+        "output_tokens": getattr(usage, "output_tokens", None),
         "total_tokens": getattr(usage, "total_tokens", None),
     }

@@ -214,8 +214,8 @@ def intercepting_callback(event_type: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
             content=content,
             raw_response=outcome.partial_output,
             tokens_used=total_usage.get("total_tokens"),
-            input_tokens=total_usage.get("request_tokens"),
-            output_tokens=total_usage.get("response_tokens"),
+            input_tokens=total_usage.get("input_tokens"),
+            output_tokens=total_usage.get("output_tokens"),
             last_call_input_tokens=outcome.last_call_input_tokens,
             partial=True,
             model=model_name,

@@ -454,10 +454,12 @@ async def test_iter_emits_awaiting_model_before_each_request(self) -> None:
         usage = outcome.result.usage
         assert outcome.total_usage == {
             "requests": usage.requests,
-            "request_tokens": None,
-            "response_tokens": None,
+            "input_tokens": usage.input_tokens,
+            "output_tokens": usage.output_tokens,
             "total_tokens": usage.total_tokens,
         }
+        assert outcome.total_usage["input_tokens"] is not None
+        assert outcome.total_usage["output_tokens"] is not None
 
     @pytest.mark.asyncio
     async def test_noninteractive_emits_awaiting_model_before_each_request(self) -> None:

@@ -15,7 +15,10 @@
 import pytest
 from pydantic import BaseModel
 from pydantic_ai import Agent
+from pydantic_ai.messages import ModelResponse, TextPart
+from pydantic_ai.models.function import AgentInfo, FunctionModel
 from pydantic_ai.models.test import TestModel
+from pydantic_ai.usage import RequestUsage
 
 from conductor.config.schema import AgentDef, OutputField, RetryPolicy
 from conductor.exceptions import ValidationError
@@ -164,6 +167,32 @@ async def test_execute_with_interrupt_returns_partial_output(
         assert output.partial is True
         assert output.content == {"result": "partial"}
 
+    async def test_execute_with_interrupt_reports_partial_token_usage(
+        self, provider: ClaudeProvider, no_mcp_manager: Any
+    ) -> None:
+        """Interrupted runs map the model's input/output usage onto AgentOutput."""
+
+        def respond(messages: list[Any], info: AgentInfo) -> ModelResponse:
+            return ModelResponse(
+                parts=[TextPart("partial")],
+                usage=RequestUsage(input_tokens=11, output_tokens=7),
+            )
+
+        agent = AgentDef(name="interrupted", model="test", prompt="do work")
+        signal = asyncio.Event()
+        signal.set()
+
+        with patch(
+            "conductor.providers._pydantic_ai.agent_builder.build_agent",
+            return_value=Agent(model=FunctionModel(respond), output_type=str),
+        ):
+            output = await provider.execute(agent, {}, "do work", interrupt_signal=signal)
+
+        assert output.partial is True
+        assert output.input_tokens == 11
+        assert output.output_tokens == 7
+        assert output.tokens_used == 18
+
 
 class TestRetryHistory:
     """Tests for retry-history capture."""
